title: Scalar Curvature Question [?64]: Are all extremal convex polyhedraP are mean convexly extremal
exact_target: Does extremality against convex polyhedra also prevent any mean-convex domain of the same face type from decreasing all dihedral angles and strictly decreasing at least one?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 6700060 (AMR-066-0060). CC BY 4.0.
